title: DuckStation 0.1-11515: official stable release
summary: DuckStation published 0.1-11515 on June 29, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation emulator project.

blocks.text: The DuckStation project published version 0.1-11515 on June 29, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: 498921157 dep/rcheevos: Bump to 9ade739. 63caefb96 dep/rcheevos: Add game list functions to rc client. 2f3067ab4 CMake: Use C99 to build rcheevos. eae17a4d7 Util: Add SQLite helpers and dynamic loading.
